notes: Zero cause/effect (eitza or cause type) edges found in torahData.js for reference 16. The dataset for Torah #16 contains only 1 bechina edge (סורא = עכו"ם) and no causal edges. The source text does contain causal relationships (e.g., the two Messiahs CAUSE the nations to be drawn in; the clouds of Esav/Yishmael CAUSE the Tzadik to withdraw from wisdom), but these are not yet represented in the dataset. When cause/effect edges are added to torahData.js for this Torah, this file should be regenerated.
